newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal approves 3rd stage BFE selloff.
newsitem.headline: Portugal approves 3rd stage BFE selloff.

text.p: The Portuguese cabinet approved the third stage privatisation of Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE) aimed at employees of the bank and its unit Banco Borges e Irmao and small investors, a statement said.
It said 2.8 million shares would be offered for sale at a privatisation price of 2,353 escudos per share, representing 3.5 percent of the capital of BFE.
Employees are entitled to 2.0 million shares and small investors 800,000.
The timing of the sale was not known.

Last August, Banco Portugues de Investimento bought a 65 percent stake in BFE at 2,615 escudos per share. In December 1994 the government sold off 20 percent of the bank to investors in a public offer for sale (OPV) on the Lisbon bourse.
